1.text: It is possible to get an education at a university.
1.lessonText: It is possible to get an education at a university.
functions: to get an education at a university.

clauses.text: It is possible to get an education at a university.

notes: It 是形式主语；不定式 to get an education at a university 是后置的真正主语。传统教学语法称不定式短语，本页归入非限定结构，不与有时态的主语从句混为一类。get 的宾语是 an education；at a university 是地点状语。

2.text: It has been done; not often, but the fact that a proportion, however small, of college students do get a start in interested, methodical study, proves my thesis, and the following personal experience I have to offer illustrates it and shows how to get around the faculty, the other students, and the whole college system of mind-fixing.
2.lessonText: It has been done; not often, but the fact that a proportion, however small, of college students do get a start in interested, methodical study, proves my thesis, and the following personal experience I have to offer illustrates it and shows how to get around the faculty, the other students, and the whole college system of mind-fixing.
functions: how to get around the faculty, the other students, and the whole college system of mind-fixing.

clauses.text: It has been done; not often,
but the fact that a proportion, however small, of college students do get a start in interested, methodical study, proves my thesis,
that a proportion, however small, of college students do get a start in interested, methodical study,
however small,
and the following personal experience I have to offer illustrates it and shows how to get around the faculty, the other students, and the whole college system of mind-fixing.
I have to offer

notes: 三个并列主句分别以 It、the fact、the following personal experience 为主语。that 从句说明 fact 的内容，不是定语从句；however small 可展开为 however small that proportion may be。do get 中的 do 不承载时态，放在实义动词 get 前作强调：这里强调“确实有一小部分学生开始了这种学习”。I have to offer 修饰 experience；省略的关系词 that 已在图中以括号补出，experience 对应 offer 的宾语。how to get around 是 shows 的疑问不定式补语。原文在长主语与 proves 之间有逗号，属于原文标点，现代仿写通常不加。

英文结构区分三个并列主句、说明 fact 内容的 Appositive clause、however small 省略让步结构和修饰 experience 的 Relative clause。补充更正：强调助动词 do 同时具有现在时形式，并非完全不承载时态；此处 I have to offer 按“我有可提供的经历”分析，have 是限定谓语，to offer 为不定式，区别于表示义务的 have to。

3.text: My method might lose a boy his degree, but a degree is not worth so much as the capacity and the drive to learn.
3.lessonText: My method might lose a boy his degree, but a degree is not worth so much as the capacity and the drive to learn.
functions: worth so much as the capacity and the drive to learn.

clauses.text: My method might lose a boy his degree,
but a degree is not worth so much as the capacity and the drive to learn.

notes: lose sb sth 是双宾语结构，表示使某人失去某物。第二主句比较学位与学习能力、动力的价值；not worth so much as 相当于 not worth as much as。to learn 与 capacity 和 drive 都有语义联系。不应按“甚至连……都不”的 not so much as + 动词解释。

4.text: My method was hit on by accident and some instinct.
4.lessonText: My method was hit on by accident and some instinct.

clauses.text: My method was hit on by accident and some instinct.

notes: 原句 was hit on 是被动式，on 属于 hit on，须保留；意思是这个方法被偶然想到。Oxford 对现代“想到主意”义标注为不用于被动，故此处按作者原文分析，现代仿写优先用主动式。by accident and some instinct 交代偶然性与直觉的作用，不是人物施事者，也不是另一分句。

clauses.text: I specialized.

notes: 只有主语与一般过去时谓语；specialized 在这里独立使用。语义可由上下文理解为专门钻研，不能在句法卡片中补出原句不存在的宾语。

6.text: With several courses prescribed, I concentrated on the one or two that interested me most and worked intensively on my favorites.
6.lessonText: With several courses prescribed, I concentrated on the one or two that interested me most and worked intensively on my favorites.

clauses.text: With several courses prescribed, I concentrated on the one or two that interested me most and worked intensively on my favorites.
that interested me most

notes: 一个限定主句，concentrated 与 worked 共用 I。with 结构内部 courses 与 prescribed 是被动关系，没有限定动词。the one or two 省略 courses；that 在其定语从句中作主语，不可省略。with 本身不固定等于 although，语境可带必修课与个人兴趣的对照。
With several courses prescribed 为非谓语背景结构，prescribed 不染限定谓语色；that 从句只到 most，worked 回到主句层级。

7.text: In my first two years, for example, I worked at English and political economy and read philosophy.
7.lessonText: In my first two years, for example, I worked at English and political economy and read philosophy.

clauses.text: In my first two years, for example, I worked at English and political economy and read philosophy.

notes: worked 与 read 共用主语 I；English and political economy 是介词 at 的并列宾语。read 是过去式，读 /red/。时间短语和 for example 都不是从句。

8.text: At the beginning of my junior year I had several cinches in history.
8.lessonText: At the beginning of my junior year I had several cinches in history.
functions: At the beginning of my junior year

clauses.text: At the beginning of my junior year I had several cinches in history.

notes: 主干是 I had several cinches；时间短语不是从句，in history 说明所属学科。这里的 cinches 是早期美国大学俚语，指容易通过、要求不高的课程或宽松教师，不是“学业警告”。本句说他在历史课上有几门容易的课；后文讨论他仍不喜欢被灌输式地教授的历史。

9.text: Now I liked history; I had neglected it partly because I rebelled at the way it was taught, as positive knowledge unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.
9.lessonText: Now I liked history; I had neglected it partly because I rebelled at the way it was taught, as positive knowledge unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.
functions: unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.

clauses.text: Now I liked history;
I had neglected it partly because I rebelled at the way it was taught, as positive knowledge unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.
because I rebelled at the way it was taught, as positive knowledge unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.
it was taught, as positive knowledge unrelated to politics, art, life, or anything else.

notes: 分号分隔两个主句；because 从句说明第二主句的部分原因。the way 后是零标记定语从句，可用 that 或 in which 引入，不能写 the way how。as positive knowledge 说明历史被当作什么来教；unrelated 是形容词，不是另一限定从句。
because 原因从句内嵌修饰 the way 的零关系词定语从句；as positive knowledge… 是 taught 的补足，仍属该从句范围。

10.text: The professors gave us chapters out of a few books to read and be quizzed on.
10.lessonText: The professors gave us chapters out of a few books to read and be quizzed on.

clauses.text: The professors gave us chapters out of a few books to read and be quizzed on.

notes: gave 带双宾语。to read 与 be quizzed on 并列、共用 to，逻辑主语为学生 us。chapters 对应 read 的宾语以及 on 的介词宾语；be quizzed 是被动，on 不能丢。

11.text: Blessed as I was with a "bad memory," I could not commit to it anything that I did not understand and intellectually need.
11.lessonText: Blessed as I was with a "bad memory," I could not commit to it anything that I did not understand and intellectually need.

clauses.text: Blessed as I was with a "bad memory," I could not commit to it anything that I did not understand and intellectually need.
Blessed as I was with a "bad memory,"
that I did not understand and intellectually need.

notes: 这是让步状语从句中的“前置表语＋as”结构：正常语序是 I was blessed with a bad memory；为让步、强调而把 blessed 前置成 Blessed as I was ...。它不是 I was 的主谓倒装。类似形式有 Tired as he was, he continued; Child as she is, she understands; Try as I might, I could not remember。to it 指 to memory，是 commit 的介词补语；较长的 anything + 定语从句后置。关系词 that 同时对应 understand 与 need 的宾语；intellectually 只修饰 need，did not 管辖后面的并列动词。
Blessed as… 使用 Concessive clause，Blessed 是前置表语，was 才是系动词；that 从句内 did not 的否定范围包括 understand 和 need。

12.text: The bare record of the story of man, with names, dates, and irrelative events, bored me.
12.lessonText: The bare record of the story of man, with names, dates, and irrelative events, bored me.
functions: with names, dates, and irrelative events,

clauses.text: The bare record of the story of man, with names, dates, and irrelative events, bored me.

notes: 主语中心词是 record，of the story of man 和 with ... 都不能误当主语。with 后只是并列名词，没有“名词＋非谓语”的独立主谓关系，不与第 6 句 with 复合结构混同。irrelative 在这里是旧式的“互不相干的”。

13.text: But I had discovered in my readings of literature, philosophy, and political economy that history had light to throw upon unhistorical questions.
13.lessonText: But I had discovered in my readings of literature, philosophy, and political economy that history had light to throw upon unhistorical questions.
functions: in my readings of literature, philosophy, and political economy

clauses.text: But I had discovered in my readings of literature, philosophy, and political economy that history had light to throw upon unhistorical questions.
that history had light to throw upon unhistorical questions.

notes: that 从句是 discovered 的内容宾语。to throw ... 修饰 light，light 对应 throw 的逻辑宾语，逻辑主语为 history；不是 have to do 的“必须”。整句相当于 history could throw light upon ...，unhistorical 指历史领域以外的。

14.text: So I proposed in my junior and senior years to specialize in history, taking all the courses required and those also that I had failed.
14.lessonText: So I proposed in my junior and senior years to specialize in history, taking all the courses required and those also that I had failed.
functions: in my junior and senior years

clauses.text: So I proposed in my junior and senior years to specialize in history, taking all the courses required and those also that I had failed.
that I had failed.

notes: proposed 表示打算，其补语是 to specialize；时间短语插在两者之间。taking 的逻辑主语是 I，补充学习计划的具体内容，不表示计划已经执行完毕。required 后置修饰 courses；those 代指课程，that 在定语从句中作 failed 的宾语。

15.text: With this in mind I listened attentively to the first introductory talk of Professor William Cary Jones on American constitutional history.
15.lessonText: With this in mind I listened attentively to the first introductory talk of Professor William Cary Jones on American constitutional history.

clauses.text: With this in mind I listened attentively to the first introductory talk of Professor William Cary Jones on American constitutional history.

notes: With this in mind 中 this 是逻辑主体，in mind 说明其状态，整组作背景状语。listen 后以 to 引出所听内容；on ... 说明 talk 的主题，不是修饰 Jones 的定语从句。

16.text: He was a dull lecturer, but I noticed that, after telling us what pages of what books we must be prepared in, he listed off some other references "for those that may care to dig deeper."
16.lessonText: He was a dull lecturer, but I noticed that, after telling us what pages of what books we must be prepared in, he listed off some other references "for those that may care to dig deeper."

clauses.text: He was a dull lecturer,
but I noticed that, after telling us what pages of what books we must be prepared in, he listed off some other references "for those that may care to dig deeper."
that, after telling us what pages of what books we must be prepared in, he listed off some other references "for those that may care to dig deeper."
what pages of what books we must be prepared in,
that may care to dig deeper."

notes: after telling ... 没有限定动词，是非限定时间结构，其逻辑主语为 he。what pages of what books we must be prepared in 是 tell 的嵌入式 wh-疑问从句，意思是“我们必须准备哪些书中的哪些页”；内部用 we must ... 的陈述语序。what pages of what books 同时是介词 in 的前置补语。for those ... 表示参考资料供哪些人使用；that 修饰 those，作 may care 的主语。be prepared in 在本文指对指定内容做好准备，现代可直接说 prepare the assigned pages。
that 宾语从句包含 telling 后的嵌入疑问 Object clause 和修饰 those 的 Relative clause。after telling 为非谓语时间结构，不标出虚构限定谓语；must be prepared 采用系表状态分析。

17.text: When the rest of the class rushed out into the sunshine, I went up to the professor and, to his surprise, asked for this memorandum.
17.lessonText: When the rest of the class rushed out into the sunshine, I went up to the professor and, to his surprise, asked for this memorandum.

clauses.text: When the rest of the class rushed out into the sunshine, I went up to the professor and, to his surprise, asked for this memorandum.
When the rest of the class rushed out into the sunshine,

notes: went up 与 asked 共用主语 I，是一个主句的并列谓语。to his surprise 是插入性评价，表示向教授索要书目这件事令他惊讶。the rest of the class 指其余同学，不是“课堂休息”。

clauses.text: He gave it to me.

notes: give sth to sb 中 to me 是接受者介词补语；可改为 He gave me the list。这里不是 gave 后直接带两个宾语的表面结构；it 回指前句的书面参考资料。

19.text: Up in the library I ran through the required chapters in the two different books, and they differed on several points.
19.lessonText: Up in the library I ran through the required chapters in the two different books, and they differed on several points.
functions: the required chapters in the two different books,

clauses.text: Up in the library I ran through the required chapters in the two different books,
and they differed on several points.

notes: and 连接两个有各自主语的主句。ran through 指快速浏览；they 指所读的两本书／其中的记载，不指作者。on several points 说明分歧涉及的方面；required 在宾语内部作定语。

20.text: Turning to the other authorities, I saw that they disagreed on the same facts and also on others.
20.lessonText: Turning to the other authorities, I saw that they disagreed on the same facts and also on others.

clauses.text: Turning to the other authorities, I saw that they disagreed on the same facts and also on others.
that they disagreed on the same facts and also on others.

notes: Turning 的逻辑主语是 I；作者转而查阅其他权威著作。they 指 authorities，即这些权威记载；others 代指 other facts。两个 on 短语并列，不是两个完整从句。

21.text: The librarian, appealed to, helped me search the bookshelves till the library closed, and then I called on Professor Jones for more references.
21.lessonText: The librarian, appealed to, helped me search the bookshelves till the library closed, and then I called on Professor Jones for more references.

clauses.text: The librarian, appealed to, helped me search the bookshelves till the library closed,
till the library closed,
and then I called on Professor Jones for more references.

notes: appealed to 与 librarian 构成被动关系，是补充说明，可释为“在我向他求助后”；to 属于 appeal to，不可删。help sb (to) do 中 to 可省，search 的逻辑主语为 me。till ... 修饰查找过程。第二主句 called on 指拜访，for ... 表目的。
appealed to 是 librarian 的补充性分词，不是限定谓语；helped 是主句谓语，search 是省 to 不定式，till 后 closed 是时间从句谓语。

22.text: He was astonished, invited me in, and began to approve my industry, which astonished me.
22.lessonText: He was astonished, invited me in, and began to approve my industry, which astonished me.

clauses.text: He was astonished, invited me in, and began to approve my industry, which astonished me.
which astonished me.

notes: He 支配 was、invited、began 三个并列谓语；不要把 invited me in 与 was 合并成被动。which 承接前面的事件，语境重点是教授赞许他的勤奋，which 作 astonished 的主语，me 是宾语。industry 为“勤奋”，不是“工业”。
was astonished 按状态性系表分析；末尾 which 指前文教授赞许我的用功这一情况，不把 industry 当作使我吃惊的单独先行词。

23.text: I was not trying to be a good boy; I was better than that: I was a curious boy.
23.lessonText: I was not trying to be a good boy; I was better than that: I was a curious boy.

clauses.text: I was not trying to be a good boy;
I was better than that:
I was a curious boy.

notes: 分号、冒号分别组织三个独立主句；冒号后的内容解释 better than that 的具体含义。第一个 was 与 trying 构成进行时；后两个 was 是系动词。比较的是求知动机，不是学习成绩。

24.text: He lent me a couple of his books, and I went off to my club to read them.
24.lessonText: He lent me a couple of his books, and I went off to my club to read them.

clauses.text: He lent me a couple of his books,
and I went off to my club to read them.

notes: lend sb sth 是双宾语结构。to my club 是介词短语，to read them 是目的不定式；后者说明离开的目的，原句没有用谓语直接断言“已经开始读”。them 回指借来的书。

25.text: They only deepened the mystery, clearing up the historical question, but leaving the answer to be dug for and written.
25.lessonText: They only deepened the mystery, clearing up the historical question, but leaving the answer to be dug for and written.
functions: to be dug for and written.

clauses.text: They only deepened the mystery, clearing up the historical question, but leaving the answer to be dug for and written.

notes: clearing 与 leaving 的逻辑主语都是 They（那些书），说明阅读后的结果。clear up 的对象是 question（问题是什么），未解决的是 answer，所以并不矛盾。to be dug for and written 为并列被动不定式，共用 to be；answer 对应 for 的宾语及 write 的宾语，for 不可省。
clearing up 与 leaving 都是非谓语补充；唯一限定谓语为 deepened，to be dug for and written 为被动不定式宾补。

clauses.text: The historians did not know!

notes: 这是完整主句；know 的具体内容由上下文补足，不能在原文词块里凭空添加宾语。感叹号强调作者发现权威也没有现成答案时的惊讶。

27.text: History was not a science, but a field for research, a field for me, for any young man, to explore, to make discoveries in and write a scientific report about.
27.lessonText: History was not a science, but a field for research, a field for me, for any young man, to explore, to make discoveries in and write a scientific report about.

clauses.text: History was not a science, but a field for research, a field for me, for any young man, to explore, to make discoveries in and write a scientific report about.

notes: 一个系表主句，not ... but ... 对照两个表语。a field for research 是 but 后的第二个表语，系动词 was 在这里省略；它与前面的 a science 对应。其后的 a field for me ... 是对这个 field 的同位语式扩展，不是另起一个与前项不对应的表语。for 分别引出逻辑主语 me 和 any young man，二者不应与 for 合并成一个词块。field 分别对应 explore 的宾语、in 的宾语、about 的宾语，后两项的介词不能省。作者在语境中反对把历史当作定论全集，不宜把这句话教成学科分类的普遍断言。

clauses.text: I was fascinated.

notes: 本句描述作者的感受，可按系表结构理解。fascinated 是“着迷的”；fascinating 才是“令人着迷的”。语境中的吸引来源是开放的历史研究空间。

29.text: As I went on from chapter to chapter, day after day, finding frequently essential differences of opinion and of fact, I saw more and more work to do.
29.lessonText: As I went on from chapter to chapter, day after day, finding frequently essential differences of opinion and of fact, I saw more and more work to do.
functions: finding frequently essential differences of opinion and of fact,

clauses.text: As I went on from chapter to chapter, day after day, finding frequently essential differences of opinion and of fact, I saw more and more work to do.
As I went on from chapter to chapter, day after day, finding frequently essential differences of opinion and of fact,

notes: As 表示“随着／在……过程中”；finding 的逻辑主语为 I，补充阅读中不断发现分歧的过程。of opinion 与 of fact 并列修饰 differences。to do 修饰 work，work 是 do 的逻辑宾语；主动不定式在此不表示工作自己做事。
finding… 是 As 时间从句内部的伴随分词结构，时间从句一直延伸到 fact 后的逗号，外层主句从 I saw 开始。

30.text: In this course, American constitutional history, I hunted far enough to suspect that the Fathers of the Republic who wrote our sacred Constitution of the United States not only did not, but did not want to, establish a democratic government, and I dreamed for a while—as I used as a child to play I was Napoleon or a trapper—I promised myself to write a true history of the making of the American Constitution.
30.lessonText: In this course, American constitutional history, I hunted far enough to suspect that the Fathers of the Republic who wrote our sacred Constitution of the United States not only did not, but did not want to, establish a democratic government, and I dreamed for a while—as I used as a child to play I was Napoleon or a trapper—I promised myself to write a true history of the making of the American Constitution.
functions: our sacred Constitution of the United States
to write a true history of the making of the American Constitution.

clauses.text: In this course, American constitutional history, I hunted far enough to suspect that the Fathers of the Republic who wrote our sacred Constitution of the United States not only did not, but did not want to, establish a democratic government,
that the Fathers of the Republic who wrote our sacred Constitution of the United States not only did not, but did not want to, establish a democratic government,
who wrote our sacred Constitution of the United States
and I dreamed for a while—as I used as a child to play I was Napoleon or a trapper—
as I used as a child to play I was Napoleon or a trapper
I was Napoleon or a trapper
I promised myself to write a true history of the making of the American Constitution.

notes: 主干依次是 I hunted、I dreamed、I promised；最后一项以解释性重启的方式具体说明梦想，原文标点较松散，不宜整句照搬为现代模板。not only did not ... but did not want to ... 共用后面的 establish a democratic government，可展开为“没有建立，而且不想建立”；从句主语在谓语前，不是 not only 前置造成的主谓倒装。as I used ... 是插入比较从句；as a child 插在 used 与 to play 之间。play 后的 I was ... 是省略 that 的内容从句，意为幻想自己是……。suspect 保留推测语气；to write 的逻辑主语仍是 I。
三条主句保留原文的重启结构。that 内容从句内嵌 who 定语从句；establish 被 did not 与 did not want to 共同支配，只显示原文一次，按共享动词使用从句谓语色。as 比较从句内嵌 play 后的零 that 内容从句；补全只在省略提示出现。

31.text: I did not do it; that chapter has been done or well begun since by two men: Smith of the University of Washington and Beard of Columbia.
31.lessonText: I did not do it; that chapter has been done or well begun since by two men: Smith of the University of Washington and Beard of Columbia.
functions: Smith of the University of Washington and Beard of Columbia.

clauses.text: I did not do it;
that chapter has been done or well begun since by two men: Smith of the University of Washington and Beard of Columbia.

notes: 分号连接两个主句。done 与 begun 共用 has been；well 修饰 begun。since 在这里独立作副词，指自那以后，不是引导原因从句的连词。冒号后两个人名说明 two men。chapter 在语境中指那项研究／写史工作。
两个主句独立；has been done 与 begun 共享完成时被动助动链，or 与 well 分开，不将连接词和副词染成谓语。

32.text: I found other events, men, and eras waiting for students.
32.lessonText: I found other events, men, and eras waiting for students.

clauses.text: I found other events, men, and eras waiting for students.

notes: find + 宾语 + doing：waiting 的逻辑主语是前面的事件、人物和时代，并非 I。此处为拟人化表达，意为仍有许多研究对象等待人去探索；students 指认真求学、研究的人。

33.text: In all my other courses, in ancient, in European, and in modern history, the disagreeing authorities carried me back to the need of a fresh search for the original documents or other clinching evidence.
33.lessonText: In all my other courses, in ancient, in European, and in modern history, the disagreeing authorities carried me back to the need of a fresh search for the original documents or other clinching evidence.
functions: in ancient, in European, and in modern history,
for the original documents or other clinching evidence.

clauses.text: In all my other courses, in ancient, in European, and in modern history, the disagreeing authorities carried me back to the need of a fresh search for the original documents or other clinching evidence.

notes: disagreeing 前置修饰 authorities；这里以权威著作指其中相互矛盾的记载。in ancient 和 in European 都省略了 history。carry me back to ... 是比喻地把作者带回某种认识。need of 在这段旧式行文中表示对……的需要；现代仿写通常用 the need for。for ... 依附 search，不是另一个主句。

34.text: Of course I did well in my classes.
34.lessonText: Of course I did well in my classes.

clauses.text: Of course I did well in my classes.

notes: do well 是“表现好”；这里 did 是实义动词，不是后接动词原形的助动词。Of course 对整句作评价；well 是副词，不能改成 I did good 来表达本句的标准书面含义。

35.text: The history professors soon knew me as a student and seldom put a question to me except when the class didn't know the answer.
35.lessonText: The history professors soon knew me as a student and seldom put a question to me except when the class didn't know the answer.

clauses.text: The history professors soon knew me as a student and seldom put a question to me except when the class didn't know the answer.
when the class didn't know the answer.

notes: knew 与 put 共用主语 professors；seldom 是修饰 put 的副词，不是谓语动词的一部分。except 后接 when 时间从句，限定“很少提问”的例外情形。class 指全班同学；a student 在本文含认真求学者之意。

36.text: Then Professor Jones would say, "Well, Steffens, tell them about it."
36.lessonText: Then Professor Jones would say, "Well, Steffens, tell them about it."

clauses.text: Then Professor Jones would say, "
clauses.label: Reporting clause

clauses.text: Well, Steffens, tell them about it."
clauses.label: Quoted main clause

notes: would 表过去反复发生的习惯，不是此处的条件句虚拟语气。直接引语是祈使句，省略的主语为 you；Steffens 是称呼语，不是 tell 的主语。them 指同学，it 指待解释的问题。
报告句与直接引语分别标 Reporting clause、Quoted main clause；tell 为祈使主句谓语，Steffens 是 Vocative，you 只列在 Ellipsis。

clauses.text: Fine.
clauses.label: Sentence fragment

notes: Fine 是独立的评价性片段，没有显式主语和限定谓语；可理解为“这当然不错”。它承接受到教授认可的情形，并引出后面的转折，不是名词“罚款”。
Fine. 保留原文及原中文说明，使用中性 Sentence fragment；不补造主语、系动词或谓语色。

38.text: But vanity wasn't my ruling passion then.
38.lessonText: But vanity wasn't my ruling passion then.

clauses.text: But vanity wasn't my ruling passion then.

notes: ruling 是修饰 passion 的分词形容词，不与 was 构成进行时；中心表语为名词短语 my ruling passion。then 限定当时的动机，不要删去后推成作者一生没有虚荣。

39.text: What I had was a quickening sense that I was learning a method of studying history and that every chapter of it, from the beginning of the world to the end, is crying out to be rewritten.
39.lessonText: What I had was a quickening sense that I was learning a method of studying history and that every chapter of it, from the beginning of the world to the end, is crying out to be rewritten.
functions: from the beginning of the world to the end,

clauses.text: What I had was a quickening sense that I was learning a method of studying history and that every chapter of it, from the beginning of the world to the end, is crying out to be rewritten.
What I had
that I was learning a method of studying history
that every chapter of it, from the beginning of the world to the end, is crying out to be rewritten.

notes: What I had 整体作主语，what 同时代表“……的东西”并作 had 的宾语，可释为 the thing that I had；常称主语从句，现代语法也称融合关系结构。两个并列 that 从句都说明 sense 的内容，不是定语从句。studying history 是介词 of 的动名词补语。is 是原文主动转用现在时，强调作者认为当下仍存在的重写需求，不应擅自改成 was。to be rewritten 为被动不定式，逻辑主语是 every chapter。
What I had 为融合关系主语结构，使用 Subject clause；两个 that 内容从句并列解释 sense，使用 Appositive clause，不误标为定语从句。

40.text: There was something for Youth to do.
40.lessonText: There was something for Youth to do.

clauses.text: There was something for Youth to do.

notes: there 是存现结构的形式成分；something 是后置名词成分，传统教学常称真正主语。for Youth to do 整体后置修饰 something；for 是引导词，Youth 才是 do 的逻辑主语，something 对应 do 的逻辑宾语。Youth 大写突出年轻一代，不是人名，也不是一个独立的对象状语。
There 为存在标记，was 为主句系动词；for Youth to do 为 something 的不定式修饰，Youth 是不定式逻辑主语。
